title: "Scheming for the World"
next_chapter_hook: "Ling Yuan retracted his gaze, fingers tapping lightly in his sleeve, a glint of sharpness flickering in those clouded old eyes—the game at Tianqing Sect seemed to hide even more intriguing variables."

text.content:
"A waning moon hung like a hook above the cliff of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Chen Ji sat alone in the decrepit Servants' Quarters, candlelight flickering, casting his lean profile in shifting shadows. The vision from moments ago still lingered in his mind—the vague silhouette of a young girl, those eyes so uncannily like his own.

Heavenly Fate Value had dropped another five points. He could clearly sense something precious draining from his body, like golden sand perpetually falling through an hourglass. But beyond this diminishment, what unsettled him more was the haziness of that foresight.

The Tianji Record never errs. Unless... someone's existence is interfering with Heavenly Secrets."

"'Tap, tap, tap—'

Three soft knocks shattered his contemplation. This was the unique signal of the Servants' Quarters—if danger approached, Mo Xiansheng would warn him this way.

Chen Ji's gaze darkened, yet he showed no panic. He rose slowly, extinguishing the candle. Darkness instantly devoured the entire room.

Through the dilapidated window lattice, he spotted several black-cloaked figures approaching from the direction of Tianqing Sect Inner Sect. Their speed was extraordinary—clearly not ordinary disciples. The silhouettes appeared and vanished in the moonlight, finally stopping thirty zhang outside the Servants' Quarters.

The leader wore a dark cyan robe, a Sect Master's token hanging at his waist.

Ling Yuan."

dialogue.content:
"'Chen Ji, come out.'

The aged yet commanding voice echoed in the night wind, carrying an undeniable pressure. 'Old man knows you're not asleep. Why pretend otherwise?'

Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his clouded eyes concealing sharp intelligence. Behind him stood three black-robed Law Enforcement disciples, all Inner Sect elites, each with cultivation at least at Foundation Building later stage.

This lineup was clearly aimed at taking a life."

text.content:
"The wooden door creaked open. Chen Ji emerged with a hunched posture, his face wearing its usual expression of timidity and fear.

'S-Sect Master?' he stammered, voice trembling. 'This disciple... this humble disciple doesn't know what wrong he's committed... why would you come personally in the middle of the night...'

Before he could finish, a fierce palm wind was already slapping toward his face!

The leading black-robed disciple had struck, ruthlessly and without hesitation, clearly intending to end his life on the spot!"

"However, just as the palm wind capable of shattering rocks was about to touch Chen Ji's brow center—

'Enough.'

Ling Yuan spoke calmly. The black-robed disciple's palm technique instantly froze, stopping a mere three inches from Chen Ji's nose.

Chen Ji still wore his expression of being scared witless, collapsing to the ground, tears and mucus flowing. Only in the depths of those downcast eyes did a cold glint flash—there and gone.

He had foreseen everything about this night half an hour ago. When the black shadows would arrive, what words Ling Yuan would speak, when the black-robed disciple would strike—all foreseen with perfect accuracy.

Including the fleeting scrutiny in Ling Yuan's eyes at this moment."

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan is testing your depth. How will you respond to this crisis?"

choices.text: "Continue feigning stupidity, playing weak to the end"
choices.description: "Maintain the useless persona, use the most卑微 posture to dispel Ling Yuan's suspicions, making him think he was being paranoid."
choices.visible_reward: "The enemy lowers their guard, exposing more trump cards"
choices.risk_hint: "If Ling Yuan doesn't believe you, your situation will become even more dangerous"

text.content:
"Chen Ji scrambled and flung himself at Ling Yuan's feet, clutching his robe hem tightly, crying bitterly: 'Spare my life, Sect Master! This humble disciple really knows nothing! I'm just a street sweeper, haven't done anything...'

His performance was flawless. Every tremor, every tear was perfectly calibrated. Ling Yuan's clouded old eyes stared at him for a long while before finally looking away."

choices.description: "While feigning ignorance, use the foresight ability to guide the situation, making Ling Yuan walk into the trap himself."
choices.visible_cost: "Heavenly Fate Value -5 (already consumed in the foresight)"
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan falls into the trap, landing in a passive situation"
choices.risk_hint: "Requires precise control of every step; margin for error is extremely low"

text.content:
"Chen Ji wept and collapsed to the ground, but at an angle invisible to others, the corners of his mouth curved slightly upward.

The instant Ling Yuan leaned in for a closer look, a dark golden talisman slipped from Chen Ji's sleeve, silently adhering to the black-robed disciple's boot sole.

The next moment, countless formation rune patterns suddenly illuminated across the entire Back Mountain!"

choices.text: "Reveal part of your trump card to intimidate"
choices.description: "Display some strength to make Ling Yuan wary, but don't expose everything—keep him guessing about your depth."
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan temporarily retreats, but will attract more attention"
choices.risk_hint: "Exposing your strength will make subsequent scheming more difficult"

text.content:
"Chen Ji trembled on the ground, but a strange aura suddenly rose from within him. The three black-robed disciples' expressions dramatically changed—they felt pressure far beyond Foundation Building level!

Ling Yuan's pupils constricted, his hand hidden in his sleeve secretly forming a technique.

'Interesting.' he murmured. 'It seems this old man truly underestimated you.'"

"Those formation rune patterns spread like living things, instantly covering an area of a hundred zhang. As the light blazed, a磅礴 prohibition force suddenly descended!

'Bind!'

Chen Ji uttered low. The black-robed disciple who had been about to kill him froze on the spot, his face full of disbelief—his spiritual energy was completely sealed!

'You—what have you done?!' The disciple exclaimed in shock and fury, struggling desperately, yet finding himself unable to move even a finger."

dialogue.content:
"Ling Yuan's expression finally changed.

He gazed at the scattered formation rune patterns, a flash of horror in his eyes—this was no ordinary formation, but an ancient forbidden technique! Throughout Tianqing Sect, besides the secret arts passed down orally by generations of Sect Masters, such a level of formation was simply impossible for anyone to master!

'Where did you obtain this formation?' Ling Yuan's voice lost its previous composure. 'Tianqing Sect's mountain protection array hasn't even been activated. How could a Servant Disciple achieve this?'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji rose slowly.

His face held no trace of timidity. Those originally clouded eyes now shone bright as an abyss, fathomless and deep. He brushed the dust from his robe with unhurried movements, as if merely tidying a trivial matter.

'Sect Master came personally in the dead of night, just to confirm whether this junior is as useless as the rumors claim, yes?'

His voice was calm, even carrying a hint of indolence: 'Now, are you satisfied?'"

"The two other black-robed disciples behind Ling Yuan immediately drew their swords, only to be pressed motionless by an invisible force. Chen Ji didn't even glance at them, merely raising his hand lightly. Those formation runes then wrapped around their ankles like having consciousness.

'No need to be hasty.' Chen Ji said calmly. 'This junior only wishes to have a proper conversation with the Sect Master tonight. After all—wasn't your design of this play simply to lure this junior into the trap?'

He smiled faintly: 'It's just that you never expected, the one in the jar has always been yourself.'"

dialogue.content:
"Ling Yuan was silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed.

That laughter began low, gradually becoming bright, finally carrying a hint of genuine appreciation: 'Good! Excellent! Magnificent!'

He repeated 'good' three times. 'This old man has lived for over three hundred years, yet this is the first time I've misjudged a junior. Chen Ji, you are far more dangerous than I imagined.'

He narrowed his eyes: 'Who—exactly are you?'"

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan directly questions your identity. How will you respond?"

choices.description: "Tell him part of the truth—about the existence of the Tianji Record, but don't mention specific abilities. Leave him suspenseful and wary."
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan will become even more wary, and may reveal more information"
choices.risk_hint: "Saying too much might make Ling Yuan determined to eliminate you"

text.content:
"Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back. Moonlight fell on his lean face, revealing a meaningful smile: 'Why does the Sect Master ask what he already knows? Haven't you been searching for something all along?'

He paused, then spoke each word distinctly: 'The—Tianji—Record.'

Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply! This name was like a thunderclap, exploding in the depths of his heart."

choices.description: "Don't answer his question. Instead, reveal information even more capable of intimidating him, throwing him into a passive position."
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan falls into a passive position; subsequent scheming becomes smoother"
choices.risk_hint: "May provoke Ling Yuan, cornered prey becomes desperate"
choices.process_label: 掌握主动权，让敌人自乱阵脚

text.content:
"Chen Ji didn't answer. Instead, he stepped forward.

Those scattered formation rune patterns surged with his step, instantly shrouding Ling Yuan as well. He smiled as he spoke: 'Why doesn't the Sect Master tell this junior first—how were you selected by the Tianji Record back then? And how... did you fail?'

Ling Yuan's expression thoroughly darkened."

"Ling Yuan's face cycled through various expressions, finally turning into a cold huff.

'So you know quite a bit.' His tone shed all pretense of gentleness, revealing his true fangs. 'Since that's the case, this old man needn't keep up appearances either.'

He waved his hand. A tremendous might exploded from within him. That was Core Formation peak cultivation! The only one in all of Tianqing Sect!

'Merely formations—' Ling Yuan sneered. 'Before absolute strength, they're nothing but paper tigers!'"

"However, Chen Ji's smile grew even wider.

'Absolute strength?' he repeated softly, as if hearing the world's greatest joke. 'Sect Master, you truly believe this junior set up this formation to trap you?'

The moment his words fell, the rune patterns beneath Ling Yuan's feet suddenly transformed—the originally binding patterns began spreading madly. A bizarre devouring force gushed forth!

'You—' Ling Yuan's expression dramatically changed. He struggled desperately, yet found his spiritual energy being extracted by that formation inch by inch!"

dialogue.content:
"'This is called the 'Heavenly Fate Diversion Formation'.' Chen Ji's voice echoed in the night wind, unhurried and composed. 'A forbidden technique specifically for cultivators above Core Formation. There are many ancient formations you've never seen, Sect Master.'

He gazed at Ling Yuan's expression of shock and fury, saying calmly: 'This junior set up this formation with only one purpose—to make you reveal your true colors before everyone.'

In the distance, several spiritual lights flickered on—the other elders of Tianqing Sect, alarmed by the formation's strange activity, heading this way."

text.content:
"Ling Yuan instantly understood Chen Ji's intentions.

Tonight, no matter his choice, he would lose.

If he forcefully broke free from the formation, he would certainly suffer major damage to his foundation, and would expose the scandal of a Sect Master attacking a junior disciple in the middle of the night before the assembled elders.

If he didn't break free and allowed the formation to drain his spiritual energy, by the time those elders arrived, his crime of kidnapping a fellow junior would be completely established.

'Your schemes run deep!' Ling Yuan ground his teeth. A great cultivator at Core Formation stage, yet cornered by a Foundation Building junior!"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji收敛了 his smile. His gaze turned as cold as frost.

'Schemes?' He walked toward Ling Yuan step by step, each step landing on those formation rune patterns. 'When the Sect Master designed murder and theft, did you think yourself scheming? When you colluded with the Demonic Path, secretly harmed fellow sect members, and stole sect secret manuals, did you feel any guilt?'

He stopped before Ling Yuan, at eye level with this Core Formation great cultivator. His voice was terrifyingly calm:

'This junior merely repays kindness with the same measure.'"

text.content:
"The spiritual lights drew ever closer.

Ling Yuan closed his eyes, drew a deep breath. When he opened them again, that Core Formation pressure had vanished completely. His face re-wore the benevolent mask, even squeezing out a few old tears.

'Chen Ji disciple, this old man came in the middle of the night merely to inquire about your cultivation...' His voice became weak and kindly. 'Who knew you would misunderstand this old man's good intentions, and even set up such a grand formation...'

choice.prompt:
Chen Ji watched this old fox's talent for instant face-changing. A cold smile flickered in his heart.

Indeed, those who could become Sect Masters all had extraordinarily thick skin."

choices.text: "Ling Yuan begins to act, to play innocent before everyone. How will you respond?"
choices.description: "Go with the flow, let him off"
choices.visible_cost: "Since the goal is achieved, know when to stop. Dismiss the formation, give Ling Yuan a way out, and keep an opportunity to observe secretly."
choices.visible_reward: "Lose the chance to slap him in the face"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan owes you a favor (though he won't admit it); subsequent scheming becomes more convenient"
choices.process_label: 欲擒故纵，放长线钓大鱼

text.content: "Ling Yuan will bear a grudge and seek revenge in the future"

choices.text:
"Chen Ji smiled faintly, raised his hand, and dismissed the formation. Those scattered rune patterns receded like an ebbing tide, as if they never existed.

'So that's how it is. This junior acted rashly.' His tone was beyond humble. 'The Sect Master teaches wisely; this junior will certainly pay attention next time.'

Ling Yuan gave him a profound look, smiled meaningfully, then swept his sleeves and departed."
choices.visible_cost: "Expose Ling Yuan's crimes before the arriving elders. Even if you can't bring him down, make him lose face and ruin his reputation."
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan's reputation suffers; loses people's hearts in the sect"

text.content: "Ling Yuan has deep roots in the sect after years of management; one strike may not be fatal"

"Chen Ji didn't dismiss the formation. Instead, he drew a crystalline Jade Slip from his sleeve.

'Elders, please wait!' His voice suddenly rose. 'This disciple has evidence here, able to prove that Sect Master Ling Yuan came tonight for murder and silencing!'
That Jade Slip sealed within it the complete footage of Ling Yuan's orders and attack just now!"

"Several elders landed outside the Servants' Quarters. After surveying the scene, their expressions varied.

The Law Enforcement Elder's brow furrowed tightly. He looked at the three black-robed disciples bound by the formation rune patterns, then at Chen Ji with his flowing robes and unscathed figure, finally fixing his gaze on Ling Yuan.

'Sect Master, what's the meaning of this?'

Ling Yuan's expression didn't change. He spoke first: 'Nothing. This old man was merely sparring with Chen Ji disciple about formation arts, disturbing everyone.'

Chen Ji lowered his head, looking modest, but a cold smile lingered in his heart—this old fox, truly adaptable."

dialogue.content:
"The Law Enforcement Elder's gaze swept between the two of them, finally landing on Chen Ji.

This Servant Disciple, he had heard of. Entering the sect three years ago, cultivation stalled—a universally acknowledged废物. But what he witnessed tonight—a废物, how could he possibly trap three Foundation Building later stage disciples, and force a Core Formation Sect Master to personally intervene?

'Chen Ji,' the Law Enforcement Elder said heavily, 'tell me, what exactly happened tonight?'

Chen Ji raised his head. Those clear eyes were full of sincerity: 'Reporting to the elder, it is indeed as the Sect Master said—we were sparring.'

His voice was calm without a trace of waves, as if that coldly calculating person from before had never existed."

text.content:
"The Law Enforcement Elder gazed at him profoundly, seemingly sensing something, yet didn't pursue further.

After the elders dispersed, Ling Yuan was the last to leave. Before departing, he glanced back at Chen Ji, his voice extremely low: 'Chen Ji, this old man admits to underestimating you. But today's humiliation—will be repaid.'

Chen Ji slightly bowed, smiling innocently: 'This junior awaits the Sect Master's visit.'

Ling Yuan冷哼一声, transformed into a stream of light vanishing into the horizon.

Night returned to stillness. Chen Ji stood beneath the moonlight, gazing at the direction Ling Yuan departed, his eyes deep and profound."
"'Well done.'
